tagline: A loop through the Southtowns hills, from the Roycroft south.
intro: Southeast of Buffalo the byway takes US 219, NY 240 and NY 242 into the foothills of the Allegheny Mountains, from Orchard Park and East Aurora south through Colden to Springville and back up by Boston.

The full byway is a loop of 108 miles that carries on into Cattaraugus County, past Griffis Sculpture Park, where steel sculptures have been going up on 450 acres since the early 1960s, and down to Ellicottville.

moments.title: Roycroft Campus
moments.text: When Elbert Hubbard could find no publisher for his book he set up his own press in East Aurora, and craftspeople gathered around him until the community numbered almost 500 by 1910.

moments.title: Springville
moments.text: The Springville Academy, opened in 1830, was the first high school in Erie County, and a farm out on Elk Street once served as training grounds for Jim Thorpe.

moments.title: Scoby Dam
moments.text: Built on Cattaraugus Creek in 1925 to make power for Springville, the 38-foot dam quit generating in 1998 and became a county park popular with steelhead anglers.
